article.story:
Champions Barcelona completed a perfect LaLiga season on home soil as a 3-1 win over Real Betis gave them a 100% record at the Nou Camp.

Raphinha scored twice to inspire victory in Robert Lewandowski's farewell appearance at the stadium, making Hansi Flick's side the first team to record a flawless slate of 19 home wins in a 20-team campaign.

The Brazil winger opened the scoring with a free-kick just short of the half-hour mark and punished a defensive error from Héctor Bellerín midway through the second half.

Isco created some intrigue when he converted a penalty heading into the final 20 minutes, but Joao Cancelo's sweetly-struck effort made things safe.
